articles.summary: This document sets out public information previously provided by Diageo plc, or else widely available in the market. Unless otherwise specified, the outlook comments below come from the Fiscal 26 Q1 Trading Statement, presentation and call script on 6 November 2025 and 2025 Preliminary Results materials with other content sourced from publicly available information.
articles.title: Diageo Aide Memoire H1 Fiscal 2026

articles.summary: 30 January 2026: Today, Diageo has completed the sale of Sheridan’s, a two-part coffee-cream liqueur, to Casa Redondo. A Transitional Services Agreement has been agreed to ensure a smooth transition and continuity of the business.
articles.title: Diageo completes sale of Sheridan’s to Casa Redondo
